claims: G is the seventh letter of the Latin alphabet
G is the SI unit symbol for grams
G commonly represents a hard /ɡ/ sound (gold)
G commonly represents a soft /dʒ/ sound (giraffe)
The latter [soft /dʒ/ sound] often occurring before E, I, or Y
G represents standard gravity (9.80665 m/s2) in science
The "opentail" or single-story G is frequently used in handwriting and fonts like Helvetica and Arial
The letter G evolved from the Greek Gamma (Γ) and Latin C
G is used in physics to denote gravity-based acceleration (g-force)
G is often represented by words like "garden," "giraffe," and "grapes"
